response.original_title: Official way Disney Cruise Line Customer Service: How to Report a Dispute
response.overview: To dispute a charge, reservation issue, or service problem with Disney Cruise Line, contact +1-888-512-8367 (US) Guest Services directly first—either onboard before disembarking or through Disney Cruise Line online.  1. Resolve Issues Onboard (Fastest Option)  +1-888-512-8367 (US) • Review your statement: Check your folio/statement before the final morning of the sailing. • Visit Guest Services: Ask a Cast Member to review questionable charges or service issues and request an encounter report or case/help ticket number for your records.  2. Contact Disney Cruise Line After Your Trip  +1-888-512-8367 (US) • Online form: Submit details—including your reservation number, dates, and issue type—via Disney Cruise Line. • Phone: Call Disney Cruise Line in the U.S. at  +1-888-512-8367 (US)  (Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET; Saturday–Sunday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM ET).
